proposal.hypothesis: Assigning four output particles to each thread should reuse each loaded source position and mass across four target-force accumulations, reducing repeated source loads. Four accumulators per target may raise register use and lower occupancy, so the factor-four mapping and 1024 logical outputs per 256-thread block are a measured candidate, not a predicted speedup.

retained: Assign four target particles per thread using target indices spaced by blockDim.x; set items_per_block to 4 * block size.
Load each source particle's position and mass once per source-loop iteration and reuse those values across the thread's valid targets, with separate force accumulators.
Bounds-check all four target indices so partial tiles and arbitrary N still produce exactly one output per valid input particle.
